discraft.settings.title: DisCraft Client Settings
discraft.settings.f2.help: Copy physical F2 screenshots to the image clipboard. Minecraft still saves exactly one original screenshot when this is off. Never automatically sends.
discraft.settings.mention.help: Play once when a new structured mention targets your Minecraft account. Plain names do not trigger it.
discraft.settings.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check client config permissions.
discraft.settings.picker.help: Resize the panel without scaling text. The actual panel fits above or below your chat input; very small space keeps it closed.
